questions.question: We've never done hockey before. Where do we start?
questions.answer: Start with Learn to Play if your child is 4 to 8 and brand new to skating. If your child can already skate without holding the wall, Mites may be the better fit.

questions.question: Does my child need to know how to skate?
questions.answer: It depends on the program. Learn to Play teaches skating from scratch. Every other division assumes your child can move on ice without holding the wall.

questions.question: How young can kids start?
questions.answer: Learn to Play accepts children as young as four. Many kids spend one or two seasons there before moving into Mites.

questions.question: Are the programs coed?
questions.answer: Yes. All LYHA programs are open to all kids regardless of gender.

questions.question: Do we have to live in Lynchburg?
questions.answer: No. LYHA has families from surrounding counties. If you can get to LaHaye Ice Center, you are in range.

questions.question: How do I know which division is right for my child?
questions.answer: Age at the start of the season is the primary factor. Learn to Play is usually ages 4 to 8. Mites is 6 to 8. Squirts is 9 to 10. Peewee is 11 to 12. Bantams is 13 to 14. U15 is 14 to 15.

questions.question: What is the difference between house hockey and travel hockey?
questions.answer: House hockey stays local. Travel hockey plays games against other clubs across the region, with some away weekends.

questions.question: My child played for a different club last year. Can they join LYHA?
questions.answer: Yes. LYHA welcomes transfers. Bring your USA Hockey registration number. For travel divisions, the standard tryout process applies.

questions.question: Can my child play two divisions at once?
questions.answer: No. Players are rostered on one team per season.

questions.question: How much does a season cost?
questions.answer: Pricing varies by division. LYHA publishes current season fees with the registration link. Email the board for the current season details.

questions.question: What does tuition cover?
questions.answer: Ice time, coaching, and USA Hockey and PVAHA registration. It does not cover personal gear or travel costs for away games.

questions.question: Is financial aid available?
questions.answer: Yes. Cost should not be the reason a Lynchburg kid cannot play. Ask any board member. The conversation is confidential.

questions.question: Are there additional fees during the season?
questions.answer: House divisions may have jamboree fees. Travel divisions may have gas, hotel, and away-weekend costs.

questions.question: What gear does a child need?
questions.answer: Helmet with cage, neck guard, shoulder pads, elbow pads, hockey pants, shin guards, skates, gloves, and a stick. Jersey details come with registration.

questions.question: Do we need gear before the first practice?
questions.answer: Not if you use LYHA's loaner program. Used equipment is available to borrow on a first come, first served basis.

questions.question: Where do we buy gear near Lynchburg?
questions.answer: Used gear is available at Play It Again Sports in Roanoke. New gear is available at Pure Hockey in Morrisville, North Carolina.

questions.question: What size gear does my child need?
questions.answer: A hockey shop can fit your child properly. For used gear, bring your child so they can try on skates and protective equipment.

questions.question: When does the season start and end?
questions.answer: House divisions usually run September through February. Travel divisions usually run September through March.

questions.question: Where do practices and home games happen?
questions.answer: LaHaye Ice Center on the campus of Liberty University, 1971 University Blvd, Lynchburg, VA.

questions.question: What is LaHaye Ice Center like?
questions.answer: LaHaye has a full-size rink, heated lobby, and locker rooms. Liberty University operates it through Club Sports.

questions.question: How do I get the season schedule?
questions.answer: The schedule is sent to families once it is finalized. The calendar page will show club events once it is connected.
